description:
A first-contact call to a non-boundary callee asks for `FunctionContract`, `Recursive`, and `DispatchMask` together before applying the contract. If the ground arguments violate the contract, the drive still derives the two activation-key facts before emitting `spec/violation`, although no callee activation will ever be created.

Current telemetry proves wasted keying work, but not the old title's “one wake late” claim. For `fixtures2/behavior/spec_violation.fz`, `AnalyzeActivation(main)` blocked on all three facts; `DeriveCallGraphComponent(M.add1)` published `Recursive`, `DeriveDispatchMask(M.add1)` published `DispatchMask`, then `DeriveFunctionContract(M.add1)` published the final prerequisite and caused the only wake; the resumed analysis immediately emitted `spec/violation`. All five current `spec/violation` fixtures have the same initial combined-prerequisite block. No current production trace or test demonstrates the narrower state “contract present while keying facts are absent.”

Goal: avoid activation-key derivation that is provably irrelevant on a drive terminating in an actionable contract violation, without regressing fz-kdt.86's one-block behavior for valid calls.

Signal:

- Add a public-telemetry regression for a rejected ground call that counts starts/completions of the rejected callee's `DeriveCallGraphComponent` and `DeriveDispatchMask`.
- Keep `an_analysis_asks_for_a_callees_contract_and_keying_facts_in_one_block` green for a valid contracted call.
- Preserve the existing `spec/violation` diagnostic and span.

Strategy: establish a reachable scheduling shape that can apply the contract before activation-key demand, then short-circuit keying only when application will immediately raise. Do not merely restore the old contract-then-keying ladder for every successful call. If avoiding the doomed work necessarily adds a second block/wake to valid calls, close this ticket as the intentional tradeoff chosen by fz-kdt.86.

Current source at origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`:

- Call paths require all prerequisites before contract application at `semantic.rs:1237-1241`, `1310-1313`, and `1452-1457`.
- `require_callee_prerequisites` unconditionally checks keying after contract readiness at `semantic.rs:1697-1705`.
- Missing key facts are registered at `world.rs:1660-1682`.
- Fatal rejection occurs only later at `semantic.rs:1760-1765`.
- Wait expansion maps them to real producers at `drive.rs:245`, `264-267`, and `398-409`.
- The existing fz-kdt.86 test covers only a successful call and explicitly requires the combined wait at `public_trace_test.rs:1412-1416` and `1446-1498`.
title: Doomed callsites eagerly derive activation-key facts before contract rejection
